buff_ahrip_tooltip:
Killing minions or monsters grants Ahri an Essence Fragment. After obtaining @MaxStacks@ Fragments, Ahri consumes them to restore @MinionHeal@ Health.

When Ahri scores a takedown against an enemy champion within @TakedownWindow@ seconds of damaging them, she feasts upon their Essence, restoring @ChampionHeal@ Health.
game_spell_tooltip_viktorchaosstorm:
Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm in an area for @StormDuration@ seconds, which instantly deals @InitialBurstDamage@ magic damage followed by @SubsequentBurstDamage@ magic damage per second to surrounding enemies. The storm automatically follows champions it has recently damaged.

Recast: Viktor can manually move the storm.

Upgraded: The storm moves @AugmentBoost*100@% faster. If a champion that the storm has damaged dies, the storm increases its size and its duration by @Tooltip_DurationExtension@ seconds (up to @MaxGrowths@ times).
game_spell_tooltip_viktorgravitonfield:
Viktor deploys a gravitational imprisonment device for @FieldDuration@ seconds, Slowing enemies inside it by @SlowPotency*-1@%. Enemies who remain within its radius for 1.25 seconds are Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Upgraded Passive: Viktor's Abilities Slow by @AugmentSlow@% for 1 second.
game_spell_tooltip_viktorpowertransfer:
Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing @TotalMissileDamage@ magic damage and granting Viktor @ShieldLevelScaling@ Shield for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals @AttackTotalDMG@ magic damage.

Upgraded: Grants @TotalAugmentedShieldValue@ Shield and Viktor additionally gains @AugmentMoveSpeedBonus@% Move Speed for @BuffDuration@ seconds.
spell_ahrifoxfire_tooltip: Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal <magicDamage>@SingleFireDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, reduced to <magicDamage>@MultiFireDamage@ damage</magicDamage> beyond the first. She also gains <speed>@MovementSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @MovementSpeedDuration@ seconds.
spell_ahriorbofdeception_tooltip: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on the way out and <trueDamage>@TotalDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> on the way back.
spell_ahriseduce_tooltip: Ahri blows a kiss that <status>Charms</status> the first enemy hit for @CharmDuration@ seconds and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
spell_ahritumble_tooltip:
Ahri nimbly dashes, firing @RMaxTargetsPerCast@ essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal @RCalculatedDamage@ magic damage each. Spirit Rush can be Recast up to 2 more times within @RRecastWindow@ seconds.

Consuming a champion's Essence with Essence Theft during this period extends the recast window by up to @PDurationExtension@ seconds and grants an additional recast of Spirit Rush (up to @RMaxCasts@ stored).
spell_viktorchaosstormguide_tooltip: Relocate the storm to another position.
spell_viktordeathray_tooltip:
Viktor fires a hextech ray in a chosen direction, dealing @LaserDamage@ magic damage to any enemies it hits.

Upgraded: An aftershock follows Hextech Ray, dealing @AftershockDamage@ magic damage.
spell_viktorp_tooltip:
Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. Every @EvolutionStackBreakpoint@ Hex Fragments Viktor obtains will permanently upgrade an active Ability. After upgrading all of his basic Abilities, Viktor can upgrade his Ultimate Ability.

Killing minions grants @MinionStacks@ Hex Fragment.
Killing cannon minions grants @CannonStacks@ Hex Fragments.
Champion takedowns grant @ChampionStacks@ Hex Fragments.
